excerpt.zh: [from.GetName]是一颗超大质量气态巨行星，其强大的引力井将数千物体吸引到其轨道上。将其进行分类编目应该会很有价值。
excerpt.en: [from.GetName] is a supermassive gas giant whose strong gravity well has swept thousands of objects into its orbit. Cataloging them may prove worthwhile.

sections.en: [from.GetName] is a supermassive gas giant whose strong gravity well has swept thousands of objects into its orbit. Cataloging them may prove worthwhile.

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]将无数的小卫星、小行星和太空碎片约束在其轨道上。放射性同位素定年表明这些东西都是在数千年前路过该恒星系的时候被它的引力井捕获的。

在对这些物体进行编目的过程中我们发现了一些古老而原始的探测器，表明存在一个正在初涉太空探索的文明。

其中大多数数据库都已经腐坏或因与其他物体撞击而损毁。但其中一个包含有一系列[from.GetName]地表的图像，时间跨度长达数百年。
texts.en:
[from.GetName] has a multitude of moonlets, asteroids, and space debris locked within its orbit. Radioactive isotope dating suggests they were all captured by the planet's gravity well while passing through the system thousands of years ago.

While cataloging these objects we found a few ancient and very basic survey probes, suggestive of a civilization making its first forays in space exploration.

Most of their data banks are either corrupted or physically damaged from collisions with other objects, but one contained a series of images of [from.GetName]'s surface spanning hundreds of years.
